title: Tonight, the Sun becomes a black hole

scenes.text: Tonight, the Sun becomes a black hole.
For eight minutes, nothing seems to change.
Earth keeps orbiting, as if nothing happened.
But here's the twist. Earth doesn't get sucked in.
A black hole with the Sun's mass has the same gravity as the Sun, so we'd keep orbiting it.
The Sun would shrink to just six kilometers across.
But without sunlight, the surface could start freezing within days.
Oceans would slowly freeze over, and most life on the surface would struggle to survive.
The good news? The Sun isn't massive enough to ever do this.
